decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.248 Whitton Dene.

Condition : 7 - If planning application 01203/248/P3 (first floor side extension to the eastern flank of the house) has been commenced then the hereby approved extension (Planning ref:01203/248/P4) will not be implemented.If this permission (Planning ref:0103/248/P4) has been commenced then the approved first floor side extension (Planning ref: 01023/248/P3) will not be implemented.The two planning permissions shall not be commenced simultaneously.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension to the house
